principles: Mastery Goals from the Assessment Plan define evidence targets.
Exit Tickets are formative-secure evidence, not exposed practice clones.
Performance Tasks and Summatives provide richer/secure evidence.
DOK is descriptive metadata, not a quota.

Across the body of repeated evidence, include enough independent variation in values, representation, context, or reasoning that mastery is not merely recall of one prompt; not every repeated opportunity must change every dimension.
map_first_repetition: Map evidence opportunities across the full requested scope before authoring; keep purposeful repetition and revise only template-driven repetition that lacks an evidence purpose.
